notes: Seed URL redirects to www.matagordatx.gov (files also served there). No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Reports are Microsoft Reporting Services text PDFs with printed Run Time. The county produced an election-night unofficial precinct report for the 2026 primary, but the copy online was uploaded 27 Mar 2026, so the primary is left UNDETERMINED for check 3. Runoff: county cumulative only on election night. 2024 general: only official reports (15 Nov 2024) are listed. Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-2): 2024_general LATER to UNDETERMINED.
tag_rationale: Results: 2024_general UNDETERMINED, 2026_primary UNDETERMINED, 2026_runoff LATER. Exactly one election is determined, so the rule gives COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS with confidence low. (Recomputed under Rule 43, 2026-10-02.)

2024_general.fact: Rule 43: no election-night file survives. Previous: Past Elections page lists for the 2024 general 'Cumulative Results -' (Cumulative Results-11-15-2024 04-32-48 PM.pdf) and 'Precinct Report - Official' (Precinct Results-11-15-2024 04-33-31 PM.pdf), both run 15 Nov 2024. The adjacent 'Cumulative Results - Unofficial' (Cumulative Results.pdf) is the May 4, 2024 election ('Election Night 05-04-2024 ... Run Time 8:09 PM', Last-Modified Sun, 05 May 2024 01:24:02 GMT), not the general. No election-night 2024 general file is listed; precinct numbers appear online with the official report.

2026_primary.fact: check 3 pending. 'Precinct Report - unofficial' (2026 Primary - precinct report.pdf, 360 pages): 'Precinct Results Report Unofficial Results MATAGORDA COUNTY, TEXAS Election Night 3/3/26 PRIMARY ELECTION ... Precincts Reporting 18 of 18 ... Run Time 9:03 PM Run Date 03/03/2026' with Election Day Voting per precinct (PDF ModDate Wed Mar 4 03:52:08 2026 UTC = 9:52 PM CST). But its Last-Modified is Fri, 27 Mar 2026 15:34:31 GMT, so when it was first posted online is not shown; the report was produced on election night but an election-night upload is not proven.

2026_runoff.fact: 'Cumulative Results (unofficial)' (Cumulative Results-5-26-2026 08-21-46 PM.pdf): 'Cumulative Results Report MATAGORDA COUNTY, TEXAS Unofficial Results PRIMARY RUNOFF ELECTION ELECTION NIGHT MAY 26, 2026 ... Precincts Reporting 18 of 18 ... Run Time 8:19 PM'; county totals. Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 01:31:11 GMT (8:31 PM CDT). Runoff files listed: this cumulative and the hand count audit; no precinct report.
